name: nestjs-audit-trail
description: Lightweight audit trail module for NestJS
author: Luiz Gonçalves <dev.luizh@gmail.com>

scripts.clean:meta: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['dist/tsconfig.lib.tsbuildinfo'].forEach((file)=>{ if(fs.existsSync(file)){ fs.rmSync(file, { force: true }); } });"
scripts.verify:dist: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['dist/index.js','dist/index.d.ts'].forEach((file)=>{ if(!fs.existsSync(file)){ console.error('Missing build artifact: '+file); process.exit(1); } });"
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run clean:meta && npm run verify:dist
